none: PAS LIN-FB54D7: Roman copper-alloy mount inscribed SALVS
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A cast copper alloy mount; it is not clear what the mount would have been attached to. The mount is rectangular, flat and now bent over double. At the left hand side of the mount is a wide rectangular panel formed by a perimeter of incised diagonal grooves. This motif is often seen enclosing inscriptions on second and third century finger rings. Within the rectangle is the inscription SALVS. To the left of the inscription, still within in the rectangular panel, are a series of crescents formed by triangular punches.
